sv.title: Astra Zeneca-topp miljontankar aktier
sv.summary: Astra Zenecas styrelseledamot Anna Manz har köpt 550 aktier i läkemedelsbolaget, enligt Finansinspektionens insynsregister.

en.title: AstraZeneca Board Member Buys Millions in Shares
en.summary: AstraZeneca board member Anna Manz has bought 550 shares in the pharmaceutical company, according to the Swedish Financial Supervisory Authority (Finansinspektionen) insider register.
